_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: With 0 of 35 recent 12h windows moving ±2+ points, this is a textbook coil where HOLD is the statistically honest graded call — no breaker has been sighted yet.
next_move.brains_agree: Split — analyst says HOLD with medium conviction citing the coil; narrative implies an imminent breakout but provides no specific trigger, so the analyst's coil discipline overrides.
next_move.confirmed_if: BTC funding spikes above 0.015% with exchange_netflow dropping below 30 and dvol_pct_30d breaking above 70 — options market makers hedging a breakout with actual supply movement
next_move.invalidated_if: VIX breaks above 22 with DXY strengthening through 101 and etf_flows collapsing below 60 — risk-off acceleration forcing re-rate toward Anxiety or Panic
